transcript: Always, always be silent in these three situations if you want more peace and less stress in your life. Number one, be silent when you are angry. A tongue filled with anger can destroy in one minute what took years to build. Peace grows where patience lives. Number two, be silent when people do not value your words. Do not waste your wisdom on people committed to misunderstanding you. Some people only hear enough to respond, never enough to understand. And number three, be silent when you want to truly listen. Wise people speak less and observe more because time and words always reveal a person's true heart. Remember this, the older and wiser you become, the less noise you carry inside you. Follow for more timeless wisdom.
